Environmental variables (single block)

Source: R/data.R
Envdf.Rd

Environmental measurements per sample used together with the species/OTU tables for correlation and Mantel-style examples.

Usage

Envdf

Format

A `data.frame` with 24 rows (samples) and 14 columns (environmental variables).

Source

Internal example data shipped with ggNetView.

Examples

data(Envdf)
head(Envdf)
